reader_summary.headline: Mitchell Green is the founder and managing partner of Lead Edge Capital.
reader_summary.overview: Mitchell Green is the founder and managing partner of Lead Edge Capital, a growth equity firm with $5 billion in assets that invests in software, internet. Lead Edge leverages its LPs, comprised of over 700 seasoned executives, entrepreneurs, deal makers, and celebrities to connect its portfolio companies with customers, partners, and talent. Unlike any other firm I've seen, the impressive list of LPs is publicly available on the firm's website.

key_points.text: Mitchell Green is the founder and managing partner of Lead Edge Capital.
Our conversation covers Mitchell's early exposure to business and finance, Lead Edge's cold-calling strategies, investment criteria, and leverage of LPs to source, diligence.
